游戏闪退或黑屏怎么办？: The game crashes or stays black?
先看启动页日志和版本设置里的崩溃分析。常见原因是 Java 版本不对、内存不够、: Check the launch log and the crash analysis in version settings. Common causes are the wrong Java, too little RAM, or a mod conflict. Turn on automatic memory, or pick Java in version settings.
模组搜不到或装不上？: Mods do not show up or fail to install?
可以用中文名搜，例如「钠」「小地图」。搜索用的是真实 Minecraft 版本号: You can search by Chinese name, for example Sodium or minimap. Search uses the real Minecraft version, even if you renamed the instance. Dependencies like Fabric API and Cloth Config are installed when possible. BMCLAPI is usually faster.
不隔离时所有版本共用存档和模组。隔离后每个版本用自己的文件夹。完全隔离还会尽量把: Off shares worlds and mods. Isolate gives each version its own folder. Full isolate also keeps assets in the version folder when possible.
外置登录皮肤不显示？: Skins from authlib login are missing?
用 LittleSkin、Blessing Skin 或 Ely.by 等皮肤站: Log in with a skin site such as LittleSkin, Blessing Skin, or Ely.by. LittleSkin is filled in by default.
iOS 上打不开游戏？: The game will not start on iOS?
需要 JIT。用 StikDebug / SideStore / TrollSt: JIT is required. Use StikDebug / SideStore / TrollStore, or turn on built-in JIT in settings (experimental). 26.3 and newer cannot launch yet.
启动器如何更新？: How do I update the launcher?
设置里可以检查更新。更新频道选「预览」时会包含测试版。正式版会通过 GitHub: Check for updates in Settings. The Preview channel includes prereleases. Release builds also prompt from GitHub Releases.
